info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Location Call Settings:  Voicemail API

params.name: locationId
params.description: Retrieve voicemail settings for this location.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Retrieve voicemail settings for this organization.

items.docs:
Retrieve voicemail settings for a specific location.

Location voicemail settings allows you to enable voicemail transcription for a specific location.

Retrieving a location's voicemail settings requires a full, user or read-only administrator or location administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_read`.

params.name: locationId
params.description: Update voicemail settings for this location.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Update voicemail settings for this organization.

items.docs:
Update the voicemail settings for a specific location.

Location voicemail settings allows you to enable voicemail transcription for a specific location.

Updating a location's voicemail settings requires a full administrator or location administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_write`.

Retrieve Voice portal information for the location.

Voice portals provide an interactive voice response (IVR)
system so administrators can manage auto attendant announcements.

Retrieving voice portal information for an organization requires a full read-only administrator or location administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_read`.

items.docs:
List the voicemail group information for the organization.

You can create a shared voicemail box and inbound FAX box to
assign to users or call routing features like an auto attendant, call queue, or hunt group.

Retrieving a voicemail group for the organization requires a full read-only administrator or location administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_read`.

params.name: locationId
params.description: Retrieve voicemail group details for this location.

params.name: voicemailGroupId
params.description: Retrieve voicemail group details for this voicemail group ID.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Retrieve voicemail group details for a customer location.

items.docs:
Retrieve voicemail group details for a location.

Manage your voicemail group settings for a specific location, like when you want your voicemail to be active, message storage settings, and how you would like to be notified of new voicemail messages.

Retrieving voicemail group details requires a full, user or read-only administrator or location administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_read`.

params.name: locationId
params.description: Modifies the voicemail group details for this location.

params.name: voicemailGroupId
params.description: Modifies the voicemail group details for this voicemail group ID.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Modifies the voicemail group details for a customer location.

items.docs:
Modifies the voicemail group location details for a particular location for a customer.

Manage your voicemail settings, like when you want your voicemail to be active, message storage settings, and how you would like to be notified of new voicemail messages.

Modifying the voicemail group location details requires a full, user administrator or location administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_write`.

Deleting a voicemail group requires a full administrator or location administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_write`.

A voicemail group can be created for given location for a customer.

info.name: Get Voicemail Group Fax Message Available Phone Numbers

params.name: locationId
params.description: Return the list of phone numbers for this location within the given organization. The maximum length is 36.

params.name: orgId
params.description: List numbers for this organization.

params.name: max
params.description: Limit the number of phone numbers returned to this maximum count. The default is 2000.

params.name: start
params.description: Start at the zero-based offset in the list of matching phone numbers. The default is 0.

params.name: phoneNumber
params.description: Filter phone numbers based on the comma-separated list provided in the `phoneNumber` array.

items.docs:
List the standard and service PSTN numbers that are available to be assigned as a voicemail group's FAX message phone number.
These numbers are associated with the location specified in the request URL, can be active or inactive, and are unassigned.

The available numbers APIs help identify candidate numbers and their owning entities to simplify the assignment or association of these numbers to members or features.
